Suez is back. Your December rate isn't.

The Rockit Manifest, Voyage 001. Four lines, four minutes:

01 / The ships are returning. Evergreen's EVER EON transited Suez on 8 Nov, its first in nearly three years.

02 / The prices aren't following. Drewry's Shanghai–Genoa spot held at $4,168/40ft, while MSC's East Med FAK goes to $6,500 from 1 Dec and CMA CGM adds a $1,600 PSS from 25 Nov.

03 / Exporters: from November shipments, the state pays up to 50% of sea and land freight to Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia, Australia and Russia (Cabinet, 5 Nov).

04 / The pound is off its low: CBE sell 53.50 against a record 56.35 in October.

Our straight answer: book December Asia cargo before 25 November.
